verdict.rationale: Mercury ships a live, OAuth-gated hosted MCP server confirmed via probe to support natural-language queries like 'What's my balance today?' and 'Graph my last 6 months of transactions' (mercury-docs-23, mercury-docs-32, mercury-probe-4). However, independent tool-inventory verification shows all 31 MCP tools are read-only (get*/list*) with zero write/send/create actions, so natural-language commands can query data but cannot execute operations like payments or invoice creation. missing for 10: natural-language-driven write/action capability (payments, transfers, invoice creation) via MCP, and broader hands-on confirmation beyond query examples.
